question: For what purpose does the speaker say they will tell briefly how success is attained?
premises: The speaker states an intention to tell.
The telling is said to be in brief.
Success is said to occur for the practitioner.
inference: The speaker will tell briefly how success is attained for the practitioner.
uncertainties: The method of success is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I tell in brief how success is attained for the practitioner.
